summary.name: Python Tricks
summary.one_liner: A email newsletter from Real Python that sends a short Python code snippet teaching one aspect of the language every couple of days.
use_cases: Learning small Python idioms bit by bit
Getting regular short Python tips by email
summary.what_it_does: The page promotes an email newsletter called Python Tricks, curated by the Real Python team. Each issue is a short code snippet meant as a teaching tool, either illustrating one aspect of Python or serving as a motivating example. The page shows sample tricks covering merging dictionaries with ** unpacking (Python 3.5+ versus Python 2.x), function argument unpacking with * and **, and lambda functions compared with def. Delivery is described as every couple of days, with unsubscribe available at any time.
notable: Short code snippets delivered by email every couple of days
Curated by Dan Bader and the Real Python team
caveats: Delivered by email only; no web archive of tricks is described on the page
